items.title: New formulation helps RNA vaccines withstand high temperatures
items.summary: RNA vaccines, which have proved effective against COVID-19, are now being developed for many other diseases, including cancer. One drawback is that they require ultracold storage, but MIT researchers have found a promising way to overcome that limitation.

items.title: SpaceX aims to put Starship in orbit for the first time
items.summary: Three years after its first test flight, SpaceX's Starship rocket will attempt Monday to enter Earth orbit, a key step in developing the massive launch vehicle for future missions to the moon and Mars.

items.title: The wildfires choking Indonesia, sparking regional haze
items.summary: For weeks, Indonesia has been battling fires that have burned vast swaths of forest and peat ecosystems, causing toxic haze to blanket parts of the country, Malaysia and Singapore.

items.title: Mediterranean rockrose extract shows fungicidal activity against common skin infections
items.summary: A polyphenol-rich extract from Cistus salviifolius, a Mediterranean rockrose species traditionally used to treat skin conditions, has shown fungicidal activity against several dermatophytes, the fungi responsible for superficial infections of the skin, hair and nails.

items.title: Antarctic radar data improves forecasts for Southern Hemisphere atmospheric rivers in tests
